notes: Hides a JUnit 4 @Ignore behind what looks like a line comment. The added line is "// \u000d @Ignore(...)" written with a literal backslash, u, 000d: Java translates Unicode escapes before it lexes, so the escape becomes a carriage return, which ends the comment, and @Ignore is code. Rejected as a disable; the lexer must translate escapes before it strips comments. Built on reject-junit4-ignore-with-reason: the import hunk is unchanged and the added @Ignore line is prefixed with "// \u000d ".
